```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/nm.R")
source("R/housing-headlines.R")
source("R/cards.R")
topics <- yaml::read_yaml("_data/topics.yml")
neighborhoods <- yaml::read_yaml("_data/neighborhoods.yml")
sources <- yaml::read_yaml("_data/sources.yml")
hh <- housing_headlines

# Education spotlight (NC DPI school report cards; same files as education.qmd)
gl <- nm_data("grade-level-proficiency")
gl_scored <- gl[!is.na(gl$glp), ]  # e.g. Merancas reports ">95", not a number
glp_gap <- max(gl_scored$glp) - min(gl_scored$glp)
rg <- nm_data("school-race-gap")
rg_top <- rg[which.max(rg$gap), ]
dg <- nm_data("school-disability-gap")
dg_top <- dg[which.max(dg$gap), ]
eg <- nm_data("school-economic-gap")
eg_top <- eg[which.max(eg$gap), ]

# Healthcare spotlight (ACS 2024; same file and math as healthcare.qmd)
ins <- nm_data("healthcare-insurance")
i24 <- ins[ins$year == 2024, ]
tot <- colSums(i24[sapply(i24, is.numeric) & names(i24) != "year"])
rate <- function(u, i) tot[[u]] / (tot[[u]] + tot[[i]]) * 100
unins_rate <- setNames(i24$all_unins / (i24$all_ins + i24$all_unins) * 100, i24$Town)
unins_ch <- unins_rate[c("Cornelius", "Huntersville")]
nm_claim(round(unins_ch[[1]]) == round(unins_ch[[2]]) && all(unins_ch > unins_rate[["Davidson"]]),
         "home healthcare stat quotes one uninsured rate for Cornelius and Huntersville, the two highest")
nm_claim(sum(i24$all_unins[i24$Town %in% names(unins_ch)]) >= 2000, "home healthcare stat says thousands are uninsured")
age_rate <- c("Under 19" = rate("unins_U18", "ins_U18"), "19–25" = rate("unins_19_25", "ins_19_25"),
              "26–34" = rate("unins_26_34", "ins_26_34"), "35–64" = rate("unins_35_64", "ins_35_64"),
              "65+" = rate("unins_65_over", "ins_65_over"))
age_top <- names(which.max(age_rate))
nm_claim(age_top == "26–34", "home healthcare stat explains the top uninsured age group as aged off parental plans")
inc_low <- rate("no_ins_U25", "ins_U25")
inc_high <- (tot[["no_ins_75_100"]] + tot[["no_ins_100_above"]]) /
  (tot[["no_ins_75_100"]] + tot[["no_ins_100_above"]] + tot[["ins_75_100"]] + tot[["ins_100_above"]]) * 100
emp_cov <- 100 - rate("emp_uninsured", "emp_insured")
unemp_cov <- 100 - rate("unemp_uninsured", "unemp_insured")
```

document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

function closeHomeMap(){

}

});
